summary.text: Ed Hibsch is the Republican candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 64, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Tip McGuire.
He was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ed Hibsch ran against McGuire, then the incumbent, in the Assembly District 64 general elections of November 3, 2020, November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
McGuire won all three, with Hibsch receiving 43.9 percent in 2020, 43.2 percent in 2022 and 44.2 percent in 2024.
Hibsch advanced from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary for a fourth race against McGuire.
